rationale.intervention_reconstruction: The hypothesis proposes substituting Hf with Sc to form a new alloy, while the target adds Cr to the existing HfMoTaTiZr base. These are different kinds of interventions (element substitution vs. addition), so they do not match.
rationale.condition_agreement: Both involve room temperature mechanical testing, but the hypothesis also specifies testing at ~1000 °C, which is absent in the target. The target focuses solely on room temperature compression, so the conditions only partially overlap.
rationale.mechanism_agreement: The hypothesis relies on solid solution strengthening from lattice distortion to maintain properties, while the target uses a dual mechanism of solid solution hardening plus crack hindrance from a reticulated Laves phase. These are different mechanistic pathways.
rationale.outcome_agreement: The hypothesis predicts reduced density with preserved strength, whereas the target reports increased yield strength and fracture strain without addressing density. The predicted property directions differ.
